name: averlo-next
description: Repository workflows for building, reviewing, and backporting reusable Averlo Next application patterns.

interface.longDescription: Averlo Next packages repository workflows for entity UI, application surface registries, component-owned loading states, Storybook-backed public UI enforcement, deterministic Figma exports, and reviewed story backports from product instances into the canonical template.
defaultPrompt: Audit this entity UI against Averlo Next
Backport approved Storybook stories into the Averlo template
